milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting dark_oak_stairs is a craft task and the crafted item ends up in the player's inventory. The player must first craft dark_oak_planks from dark_oak_logs (using the 2x2 grid or crafting table), then use 6 planks in a stair pattern on the crafting table to produce dark_oak_stairs. min_count=1 is used because the task is simply to craft the item — having at least 1 confirms the craft was completed successfully regardless of exact recipe yield.

Uses inventory_has because crafting dark_oak_door is a craft task and the crafted item ends up in the player's inventory. After completing the stairs, the player uses remaining dark_oak_planks (6 planks in a 2x3 door pattern) at the crafting table to craft dark_oak_doors. min_count=1 is used because the task is to craft the item — having at least 1 confirms successful completion regardless of exact recipe yield.
